name: cmux-workflow
description: Run parallel coding agents as cmux panes and actually know when they finish. Skills and commands for dispatching codex/grok/claude lanes, watching them with a signal that cannot lie (cmux's own turn-hook session store, not `pgrep`), surviving conversation compact (self-invoke + CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md), auditing lanes you forgot to watch, and cleaning them up. Installs and runs in Claude Code, codex and grok — the skills call out the one place the three hosts genuinely differ. Every rule in here comes from a measured failure in a real session, not from theory. Also ships `orca-orchestration` for Orca-hosted lanes, whose completion signal is read off the live input box because Orca's `tui-idle` reports idle mid-turn and codex's `Worked for` footer is absent on short turns.
